_comment: Phase-2 source B, d=4 EXTENSION of atlas_full_v0 (the d in {2,3} build). d=base_species_count=4 ONLY (the d<=3 atlas at atlas_full/atlas.sqlite is unchanged; this builds the 2467 new d4 networks of the d<=4 mu5 family — est_d4 enumerated d in {2,3,4} mu5 = 5240 = d2(596)+d3(2177)+d4(2467)). mu=max complex support/order stays 5 (homomeric/mixed complexes AAAAA..BBBBC in scope). FULL PARITY with the d<=3 run: sqlite_persist_mode=full, compute_volume=true, change_expansion.max_active_dims=1 (single-axis slices the v0 phenotyper can sweep), network_parallelism=128. Writes to atlas_d4/atlas.sqlite on /raid (60+ TB mechanical disk) to avoid the SSD quota; ATLAS_SQLITE_PATH env overrides sqlite_path at run time.
